body: Covers the S170-45 arena allies work: the roster-audit wall (every remaining hero blocked on a missing system), the founder's build-allies decision, arena_nearest_ally unblocking Ghost/Frog/Doc Wheel, and the honest bug-in-my-own-test story (an assertion passing by coincidence, not correctness).
